_comment: Guest reviews shown at the foot of the home page.
"placeholder": true marks a card as a template rather than a real
review. Those render greyed, with the quote dashed and a PLACEHOLDER
chip over it, so nobody mistakes one for something a guest wrote and
To use one: paste the real review into "quote", put the reviewer's
name in "name", name the site in "source", set "rating", and set
"placeholder" to false. The card styles itself from there.
Only quote real reviews, from the platform they were left on. The one
real entry below is the review already quoted on the site.
"url" is optional — point it at the review so a reader can check it.
heading: What guests say
lede: Twenty-five years of them. These are the ones we keep going back to.
